parameters.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('new','waiting')) AS pending_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'running') AS running_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('error','crashed') AND "startedAt" > now() - interval '1 hour') AS errors_last_hour,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "startedAt" > now() - interval '1 hour') AS total_last_hour
FROM execution_entity;
